ready.feedback_bad: Square to the net under the lob — turn sideways earlier.
ready.ideal: Turn sideways, non-hitting arm tracking the ball.

unit_turn.feedback_bad: Not enough turn — rotate the shoulders under the ball.

takeback.feedback_bad: Racquet is late going up — get it behind the head sooner.
takeback.ideal: Racquet behind the head before the ball peaks.

racquet_drop.feedback_bad: Casting the racquet — drop it behind the back first.

acceleration.feedback_bad: Arming the smash — use the legs and uncoil.
acceleration.ideal: Legs and core drive the racquet up.

contact.feedback_bad: Letting the ball drop too low — take it higher.
contact.ideal: Contact at full reach above the head.

extension.feedback_bad: Pulling down early — hit up and through.
extension.ideal: Reach up and across after contact.

finish.feedback_bad: Falling away — finish balanced and recover.
finish.ideal: Land balanced, racquet past the hip.
